description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares its manifest, and answers a health probe against a workdir that has published nothing yet. The probe is what builds and publishes gen-1, so the generation and the watermarks appear here rather than at initialize — building an index inside the handshake would compete with the core's handshake timeout on any real corpus. The health diagnostics name the store this instance opened, hashed: `recall doctor` compares the value only for equality between two instances of one adapter, so a digest serves it exactly as well as a path and cannot leak a home directory into a committed transcript.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
